import unittest

from solution import Unit, UnitManager


class UnitManagerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unit_validation(self):
        for name in ("", None, 3):
            with self.subTest(name=name), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Unit(name)
        for state in ("", "started", None, 1):
            with self.subTest(state=state), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Unit("worker", state)

    def test_defaults_and_empty_history(self):
        unit = Unit("worker")
        manager = UnitManager()
        self.assertEqual(unit.name, "worker")
        self.assertEqual(unit.state, "missing")
        self.assertEqual(manager.events, ())

    def test_full_lifecycle_preserves_identity_and_event_order(self):
        unit = Unit("worker")
        manager = UnitManager()

        self.assertIs(manager.activate(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(unit.state, "active")
        self.assertEqual(manager.events, (("create", "worker"), ("start", "worker")))

        self.assertIs(manager.activate(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(manager.events, (("create", "worker"), ("start", "worker")))

        self.assertIs(manager.suspend(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(unit.state, "paused")
        self.assertEqual(manager.events[-1], ("stop", "worker"))

        self.assertIs(manager.suspend(unit), unit)
        self.assertIs(manager.activate(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(unit.state, "active")
        self.assertEqual(manager.events[-1], ("start", "worker"))

        self.assertIs(manager.remove(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(unit.state, "missing")
        self.assertEqual(manager.events[-1], ("remove", "worker"))

        before = manager.events
        self.assertIs(manager.remove(unit), unit)
        self.assertEqual(manager.events, before)

    def test_managers_have_independent_read_only_histories(self):
        first = UnitManager()
        second = UnitManager()
        first.activate(Unit("a"))
        self.assertEqual(second.events, ())
        with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            first.events = ()

    def test_operations_reject_non_units(self):
        manager = UnitManager()
        for operation in (manager.activate, manager.suspend, manager.remove):
            for value in (None, "unit", {}, object()):
                with self.subTest(operation=operation.__name__, value=value), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    operation(value)
        self.assertEqual(manager.events, ())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
